NarGINA: Towards Accurate and Interpretable Children’s Narrative Ability Assessment via Narrative Graphs
record.reason: NarGINA is a clinical-linguistic narrative-ability assessment candidate. Physical pages3–4 describe real children aged3–13 narrating a wordless picture book under clinical-linguistics guidance, expert scoring by clinicians/educators, and gold-standard narrative graphs; page6 evaluates the resulting Chinese narrative-assessment corpus. Its actual outputs are narrative ability scores and interpretable completeness/coherence traits, not validated disease diagnoses. The task is specifically motivated and designed for language-disorder assessment/intervention, rather than general essay scoring; retain as a medical-adjacent clinical-language candidate with this limitation.
